convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call 'ElderImpulseSystem' custom indicator with 4 buffers, plus #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> external library for position management. The core signal logic depends on the custom indicator's buffer values, requiring manual reimplementation of the Elder Impulse System logic in Python.

derived_values.name: ElderImpulseSystem buffer value
derived_values.formula: iCustom('ElderImpulseSystem', ma_period=13, fast_ema=12, slow_ema=26, signal=9) buffer 4, reading 2 bars at SignalBar offset. Value==2 means bullish impulse, Value==1 means bearish impulse, Value==0 means neutral

derived_values.name: Impulse State Transition
derived_values.formula: Value[1]==2 (current bar bullish) AND (Value[0]==1 OR Value[0]==0) (previous bar was bearish or neutral) => long entry signal. Value[1]==1 (current bar bearish) AND (Value[0]==0 OR Value[0]==2) (previous bar was neutral or bullish) => short entry signal

other_exits: Long position closed when ElderImpulseSystem buffer==1 (bearish impulse detected)
Short position closed when ElderImpulseSystem buffer==2 (bullish impulse detected)
BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags can disable signal-based closing

custom_logic_notes: The Elder Impulse System is a well-known indicator by Alexander Elder combining EMA(13) slope with MACD histogram direction. When both are bullish, bar is green (Value=2); both bearish, bar is red (Value=1); mixed, bar is blue/neutral (Value=0). Entry requires a STATE TRANSITION: long only when transitioning from non-bullish (0 or 1) to bullish (2); short only when transitioning from non-bearish (0 or 2) to bearish (1). The iCustom call reads buffer index 4. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar helper functions. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the most recently completed bar (not the forming bar).
python_conversion_notes: Reimplement Elder Impulse System directly: EMA(13) slope direction (up=1, down=-1) combined with MACD(12,26,9) histogram direction (up=1, down=-1). When both +1, impulse=2 (bullish); both -1, impulse=1 (bearish); mixed, impulse=0 (neutral). Entry on state transitions: long when impulse transitions from 0 or 1 to 2; short when impulse transitions from 0 or 2 to 1. Signal-based closes are the reverse. SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points. Position sizing: 0.1 lots (LOT mode). Only trade on new bar formation. No external library needed — all logic can be expressed with standard EMA and MACD calculations.
